description: This file defines the SplashScreen activity for an Android application. It initializes UI elements, sets status bar color, retrieves stored driver data, and navigates to either the login screen or main activity based on the presence of saved data. It also fetches additional vehicle and driver details asynchronously.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: An Android activity acting as a splash screen that initializes app state, loads user data, and navigates to login or main screen based on stored information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen UI, sets system UI flags, retrieves stored driver data, and starts a timer to transition to the login or main activity after a delay.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses JSON response containing driver details, updates global variables, fetches additional vehicle and driver info asynchronously, and navigates to the main activity if data is valid.
